title: POST /v0.1/spheres/{sphere}/blobs (201)
description: A blob the Obysphere now keeps, ciphertext only (spec/sphere-api.md section 10): its id, the SHA-256 and size of what it received, when it stops serving it, and the members it is for, in code-point order. An offer, an update or a version names it with {id, sha256, bytes, expires}. Comes with the feature artifacts.
